title: BORED
author: Sidzzz

scanner.why: end_game name an ending and are this map's own; script hardcodes cost 60000

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: One fine day of an immaculate timing at the very brink of Fall, four of the most unlikely characters one could possibly imagine, namely Captain America, Deadpool, Master Chief and Shadow, all find themselves mysteriously impelled to journey to one particularly mystical location, correspondingly within all their meandering timelines. Upon arrival, they abruptly discover a most crudely designed object, barren and with an exuberant fraternity of colors. Uncomprehending of the dangers that lay in inevitable peril, ardently waiting for its prey, they hasten to embrace their profoundly irrational thoughts and decide to land a trod upon it. A decision which they soon find themselves compelled to deem the very worst and most perilous decision they had taken within the confinements of the entirety of their lifetimes. Instantaneously. they are teleported to a warehouse-turned-bungalow located at the very heart of a medieval forest, accompanied, rather unceremoniously, by none other than the incrementally inhumane and of an innumerable population, the undead. Welcome to Bored, my first ever Custom Zombie Map, and I do hope you shall find it far from the name’s ill-favoring illumination. Features Attractive Zombie Counter Advanced Warfare Reminiscent Sliding Movement Black Ops and Black Ops II Perks Black Ops Viewhands Black Ops II Bank System Black Ops II Muzzle-flashes Blood Spatter HUD Effect Blue Zombie Eye Effects Bonus Points Powerup Buyable C4 Buyable Ending Custom Mystery Box Mod
